card.name: Look and feel verbs after a subject
card.fires_on: The verb look (looks, looking) or feel right after a subject such as we, she or they. It is common in phrases like look forward, look for, look to, and look like.

modes.label: look for / look forward
modes.description: The verb look right after a subject, leading into for, forward or to.

modes.label: appearance or feeling
modes.description: Look or feel describing how someone or something seems.

card.writes: It promotes words like really, forward, exhausted and satisfied, which fit after look or feel.
card.plain: It fires on the verb look or feel after a subject, just before words like forward, for or like.
